## What does this change?

<!-- A short summary of the change and which ingredient(s) or pipeline stage it touches. -->

## Why

<!-- The real need behind it. Which project or situation showed this was worth changing? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Fix to an existing ingredient (inaccurate / unclear / out of date / broken link)
- [ ] New ingredient (template / skill / MCP / service / reference / standard)
- [ ] Pipeline / skills change
- [ ] Docs only (README, standards, contributing, etc.)

## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to one logical change
- [ ] Placed in the correct warehouse category
- [ ] States what it is, when to use it, and when **not** to use it
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or project-specific detail included
- [ ] Authoritative sources linked; assumptions and limits noted
- [ ] Explained how it was validated in practice
- [ ] Any index tables / category READMEs updated to reference it
- [ ] Links resolve and Markdown renders cleanly
